title: Tencent WorkBuddy App Update Released, Supports Viewing and Initiating AI Tasks on Mobile Devices
excerpt: Tencent WorkBuddy App has recently been updated, adding the ability to view and initiate tasks on mobile devices, further enhancing the AI Agent cross-device co
content_html:
Tencent WorkBuddy App has recently been updated, adding the ability to view and initiate tasks on mobile devices, further enhancing the AI Agent cross-device collaboration experience. Zhang Jun, Director of Tencent's Public Relations, stated in a post that the cloud synchronization feature previously concerned by users has been largely achieved. After the update, tasks can be managed on mobile devices and real-time synchronization between tasks and outputs is now possible.

According to the introduction, the updated WorkBuddy supports managing multiple computers at the same time. Users can check task progress on different devices through their mobile devices and perform task operations. Whether tasks are executed on the computer or requests are initiated via the mobile device, the task status and generated content will remain synchronized.

This upgrade further expands the application scenarios of AI Agent, allowing users to no longer be limited to operating on a single device. As AI assistants gradually evolve from simple question-and-answer tools into intelligent agents capable of performing tasks, multi-device collaboration and cross-terminal management are becoming key directions for enhancing the practicality of intelligent agents.

content_html_zh:
腾讯WorkBuddy App近期更新，增加了在移动设备上查看和发起任务的功能，进一步增强了AI Agent跨设备协作体验。 腾讯公关总监张军发文表示，之前用户关心的云同步功能已经基本实现。 更新后，可以在移动设备上管理任务，并且现在可以实现任务和输出之间的实时同步。

据介绍，更新后的WorkBuddy支持同时管理多台电脑。 用户可以通过移动设备查看不同设备上的任务进度并进行任务操作。 无论任务是在计算机上执行还是通过移动设备发起请求，任务状态和生成的内容都将保持同步。

此次升级进一步拓展了AI Agent的应用场景，让用户不再局限于单一设备上操作。 随着人工智能助手逐渐从简单的问答工具演变为能够执行任务的智能代理，多设备协作和跨终端管理正在成为增强智能代理实用性的关键方向。
